💈Hamilton holds a special place in our journey.💈🎓 

The Muamba foundation in partnership with BSD had the opportunity to bring Hair for Self-Esteem to Cathedral High School, providing free haircuts, mentorship, and meaningful conversations around confidence, self-esteem, and personal growth.

What makes this school even more special is its place in history. Cathedral High School was the first high school in Ontario to introduce a barbering curriculum, creating opportunities for students to explore skilled trades and entrepreneurship long before many others recognized the value of the industry.

As an organization that uses barbering and hairstyling as tools for confidence, mentorship, and career development, it was inspiring to connect with a school that shares a similar vision.

A huge thank you to the staff, students, and leadership team for welcoming us into your community.

We’re excited to share that we’ll be returning this fall to continue building confidence, creating opportunities, and supporting the next generation of leaders.

Confidence starts with hygiene. Growth starts with opportunity.

See you soon, Hamilton.
